headline: Flagg's free throws hold off Utah's 16–0 run
dek: The Mavericks led by 17 after three quarters, gave up a 16–0 run, and won it on Cooper Flagg’s free throws with 3.6 seconds left.
three: Cooper Flagg: 28 points and the winning free throws
8 of 17 from the floor, 3 of 7 from three, 9 of 10 at the line.
Mavericks up 17 after three, then held off a 16–0 run
All five Mavericks starters scored in double figures.
Won it with 16 steals and in the paint
Steals 16–6; points in the paint 50–42. Dallas had 16 steals to Utah’s 6.
top: 9 of 10 FT, the winning free throws
8 assists, all 16 in the first half
